`class TextNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.text` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/text/TextNode.java)

Draws a Text in its bounds, and takes the size of the text when no size is declared.

![The word Text in grey, centered on a light card](/captures/catalog-nodes-textnode.webp)

## Description

The style comes from the [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) and its [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/); the mode decides how a text wider than the node is shown.
The node measures its text in `update()`, so a layout node sees a change of text on the same frame; an empty or `null` text gives a size of `0` on each axis that is not declared.
